papers.title: Approximate and Weighted Data Reconstruction Attack in Federated Learning
papers.abstract: Federated Learning (FL) is a distributed learning paradigm that enables multiple clients to collaborate on building a machine learning model without sharing their private data. Although FL is considered privacy-preserved by design, recent data reconstruction attacks demonstrate that an attacker can recover clients' training data based on the parameters shared in FL. However, most existing methods fail to attack the most widely used horizontal Federated Averaging (FedAvg) scenario, where clients share model parameters after multiple local training steps. To tackle this issue, we propose an interpolation-based approximation method, which makes attacking FedAvg scenarios feasible by generating the intermediate model updates of the clients' local training processes. Then, we design a layer-wise weighted loss function to improve the data quality of reconstruction. We assign different weights to model updates in different layers concerning the neural network structure, with the weights tuned by Bayesian optimization. Finally, experimental results validate the superiority of our proposed approximate and weighted attack (AWA) method over the other state-of-the-art methods, as demonstrated by the substantial improvement in different evaluation metrics for image data reconstructions.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文讨论联邦学习中的数据重建攻击，与有限元代理建模或生物力学设计完全无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper is a pure machine learning security study on federated learning data reconstruction, with no connection to FEA surrogate modeling, constraint handling, uncertainty quantification, or biomechanical implant design.

summary_zh.motivation: 联邦学习中客户端数据易被重建攻击，现有方法对FedAvg场景无效。
summary_zh.method: 提出基于插值的近似方法和逐层加权损失函数，并用贝叶斯优化调整权重。
summary_zh.result: 所提方法在图像数据重建上显著优于现有技术。
summary_zh.validation: 在图像数据集上对比多种攻击方法的评价指标。

summary_en.motivation: Existing data reconstruction attacks fail in horizontal Federated Averaging scenarios where clients share model parameters after multiple local updates.
summary_en.method: An interpolation-based approximation generates intermediate model updates, and a layer-wise weighted loss function with Bayesian optimization tunes layer weights to improve reconstruction quality.
summary_en.result: The proposed approximate and weighted attack (AWA) method substantially improves image data reconstruction metrics compared to state-of-the-art methods.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on standard image datasets using reconstruction quality metrics (e.g., MSE, SSIM).

papers.title: Learning fast, accurate, and stable closures of a kinetic theory of an active fluid
papers.abstract: Important classes of active matter systems can be modeled using kinetic theories. However, kinetic theories can be high dimensional and challenging to simulate. Reduced-order representations based on tracking only low-order moments of the kinetic model serve as an efficient alternative, but typically require closure assumptions to model unrepresented higher-order moments. In this study, we present a learning framework based on neural networks that exploit rotational symmetries in the closure terms to learn accurate closure models directly from kinetic simulations. The data-driven closures demonstrate excellent a-priori predictions comparable to the state-of-the-art Bingham closure. We provide a systematic comparison between different neural network architectures and demonstrate that nonlocal effects can be safely ignored to model the closure terms. We develop an active learning strategy that enables accurate prediction of the closure terms across the entire parameter space using a single neural network without the need for retraining. We also propose a data-efficient training procedure based on time-stepping constraints and a differentiable pseudo-spectral solver, which enables the learning of stable closures suitable for a-posteriori inference. The coarse-grained simulations equipped with data-driven closure models faithfully reproduce the mean velocity statistics, scalar order parameters, and velocity power spectra observed in simulations of the kinetic theory. Our differentiable framework also facilitates the estimation of parameters in coarse-grained descriptions conditioned on data.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文使用神经网络构建替代模型，通过主动学习和可微求解器实现高效且稳定的闭包预测，其方法可迁移到生物力学有限元代理建模中。
llm.why_not_core: The paper does not address finite element analysis, implant biomechanics, or structural optimization; its application is limited to active fluid kinetic theory.

summary_zh.motivation: 动力学理论模拟计算成本高，需要降阶闭包模型
summary_zh.method: 利用旋转对称性的神经网络学习闭包，结合主动学习和可微求解器
summary_zh.result: 数据驱动闭包准确稳定地复现了速度统计量和功率谱
summary_zh.validation: 与动力学模拟的直接数值结果对比验证

summary_en.motivation: Kinetic theories for active matter are high-dimensional and computationally expensive, necessitating reduced-order closures.
summary_en.method: A neural network exploiting rotational symmetries learns closure terms from simulations, coupled with active learning and a differentiable pseudo-spectral solver for stable a-posteriori inference.
summary_en.result: The data-driven closure accurately reproduces mean velocity, order parameters, and power spectra of the full kinetic model.
summary_en.validation: A-priori and a-posteriori comparisons against kinetic simulations validate accuracy and stability.

papers.title: A practical PINN framework for multi-scale problems with multi-magnitude loss terms
papers.abstract: For multi-scale problems, the conventional physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) face some challenges in obtaining available predictions. In this paper, based on PINNs, we propose a practical deep learning framework for multi-scale problems by reconstructing the loss function and associating it with special neural network architectures. New PINN methods derived from the improved PINN framework differ from the conventional PINN method mainly in two aspects. First, the new methods use a novel loss function by modifying the standard loss function through a (grouping) regularization strategy. The regularization strategy implements a different power operation on each loss term so that all loss terms composing the loss function are of approximately the same order of magnitude, which makes all loss terms be optimized synchronously during the optimization process. Second, for the multi-frequency or high-frequency problems, in addition to using the modified loss function, new methods upgrade the neural network architecture from the common fully-connected neural network to special network architectures such as the Fourier feature architecture, and the integrated architecture developed by us. The combination of the above two techniques leads to a significant improvement in the computational accuracy of multi-scale problems. Several challenging numerical examples demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed methods. The proposed methods not only significantly outperform the conventional PINN method in terms of computational efficiency and computational accuracy, but also compare favorably with the state-of-the-art methods in the recent literature. The improved PINN framework facilitates better application of PINNs to multi-scale problems.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种针对多尺度问题的PINN损失函数改进方法，可迁移至生物力学代理模型，但未涉及植入体或不确定性量化。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on multi-scale PDEs without uncertainty quantification, constraint handling, or any biomedical/implant application, making it not directly applicable to implant design optimization under uncertainty.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决多尺度问题中PINN损失项量级差异大导致优化困难。
summary_zh.method: 提出分组正则化策略调整损失项量级，并采用傅里叶特征等网络结构。
summary_zh.result: 数值算例显示计算精度和效率显著优于传统PINN及现有方法。
summary_zh.validation: 通过多个多尺度PDE数值算例验证方法有效性。

summary_en.motivation: The paper addresses the challenge of training physics-informed neural networks on multi-scale problems where loss terms have disparate magnitudes.
summary_en.method: It introduces a grouping regularization strategy to rebalance loss terms and combines it with specialized architectures like Fourier features.
summary_en.result: Numerical experiments demonstrate significant improvements in accuracy and efficiency compared to standard PINNs and state-of-the-art methods.
summary_en.validation: The method is validated on several challenging multi-scale PDE examples, showing superior performance.

papers.title: Plastic deformation behavior and strengthening mechanism of SLM 316L reinforced by micro-TiC particles
papers.abstract: In this work, the integrated study on the microstructure evolution , plastic deformation behavior, and strengthening mechanism of Selective Laser Melting (SLM) 316L austenitic stainless steel (ASS) reinforced with micro-TiC particles was investigated. The results indicated that there were lots of small angle grain boundaries in SLM 316L ASS, and the high dislocation density and component segregation of the cellular dislocation structure resulted in a good combination of high strength and good elongation in performance. The tensile strength , yield strength, and elongation of SLM 316L ASS were 682 MPa, 571 MPa, and 49.9%, respectively. The addition of TiC reinforced particles induced microstructure evolution, including grain refinement, reduction of epitaxial columnar dendrites , reduction of low angle grain boundary (LAGB) ratio and increase of Σ3 (60°/<111>) twin boundaries. Through the effects of grain refinement strengthening, Orowan strengthening, and dislocation strengthening, SLM 316L-2TiC showed a higher tensile strength of 1021 MPa and higher yield strength of 809 MPa, while maintaining an elongation of 30.8% due to the suppression of plasticity by twinning induced plasticity (TWIP) effect. Although nano-reinforced particles were commonly used to improve mechanical properties, in our work, we chose to add micrometer-sized TiC particles, and the strength of the SLM 316L-2TiC metallic matrix composites (MMCs) exceeded the previous reports of adding nanoparticles . The reason was that the small contact angle between TiC and 316L provides good wettability between the particles and the melt, and the selection of laser processing parameters ensures good bonding between TiC particles and the substrate. • We chose to add micrometer-sized TiC particles to make 316L-2TiC MMCs. • The SLM 316L-2TiC MMCs in our work exhibit excellent mechanical properties. • The microstructural evolution, plastic deformation mechanism, and strengthening mechanism of 316L-2TiC MMCs were conducted.

papers.title: The Effects of Different Femoral Component Materials on Bone and Implant Response in Total Knee Arthroplasty: A Finite Element Analysis.
papers.abstract: Due to the high stiffness of the biomaterials used in total knee arthroplasty, stress shielding can lead to decreased periprosthetic bone mineral density and bone resorption. As different materials and 3D-printed highly porous surfaces are available for knee femoral components from the industry nowadays, this study aimed to compare the effects of two same-design cruciate-retaining femoral components, made with CoCr and titanium alloy, respectively, on periprosthetic bone stresses through a finite element model of the implanted knee in order to evaluate the induced stress shielding. Moreover, the effect of the cementless highly porous surface of the titanium implant was analyzed in comparison to the cemented interface of the CoCr implant. The von Mises stresses were analyzed in different periprosthetic regions of interest of the femur with different configurations and knee flexion angles. The titanium component induced higher bone stresses in comparison with the CoCr component, mostly in the medial compartment at higher knee flexion angles; therefore, the CoCr component led to more stress shielding. The model was revealed to be effective in describing the effects of different femoral component materials on bone stress, highlighting how a cementless, highly porous titanium femoral component might lead to less stress shielding in comparison to a cemented CoCr implant with significant clinical relevance and reduced bone resorption after total knee arthroplasty.

summary_zh.method: 建立全膝关节置换有限元模型，分析CoCr和钛合金股骨组件在不同屈曲角度下的骨应力。
summary_zh.result: 钛合金组件诱导更高的骨应力，CoCr组件导致更多应力遮挡。
summary_zh.validation: 有限元仿真验证材料对骨应力分布的影响。

summary_en.motivation: To compare the effects of CoCr and titanium femoral components on periprosthetic bone stresses and stress shielding in total knee arthroplasty.
summary_en.method: A finite element model of an implanted knee was developed to analyze von Mises stresses in different periprosthetic regions under various flexion angles.
summary_en.result: The titanium component induced higher bone stresses than CoCr, indicating less stress shielding with the titanium implant.
summary_en.validation: The study relied on finite element simulation without experimental validation.
